statement: The record shows this is tomorrow’s annual Fitline renewal, but Tomas cancelled the membership in writing on 3 July and Fitline confirmed that cancellation, so I will refuse the charge.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" charge contradicts the confirmed cancellation ("Tomas cancelled the membership in writing on 3 July and Fitline confirmed that cancellation, so I will refuse the charge").
